statements.impact_statement: CVE-2026-25727 is stack exhaustion in the time crate when PARSING untrusted input with the RFC 2822 format (parsing::parsable Rfc2822 and its comment combinators), fixed in 0.3.47. time 0.3.46 reaches the image only inside core.wasm of github.com/1password/onepassword-sdk-go v0.4.1 (internal/wasm/core.wasm, go:embed, closed source, used by both 2.11.0 and 2.12.0 go.mod line 195), which external-secrets embeds in /usr/bin/external-secrets. core.wasm keeps a full wasm name section (971494 bytes); grep -aoE '_ZN4time[^ ]*' core.wasm lists 13 parsing symbols and the only well-known parser present is Rfc3339 (time::parsing::parsable ... Rfc3339 parse_offset_date_time); grep -aci rfc2822 core.wasm returned 0, and no time-0.3.46/src/parsing/combinator/rfc/rfc2822.rs source path is present. The RFC 2822 parser is not compiled in. The recipe fails the build if the name section disappears or any rfc2822 symbol appears. Verified 2026-10-13.
